pluginstrument.author: Detlef von Reusner
pluginstrument.description: For MSFS PMDG 737-700. Illumination options are per user properties: Day, Night, Real. The Ambient Light Dimmer Instrument is needed for option "Real". (From SIMSTRUMENTATION) Illumination is based on the daylight value the instrument gets from the Generic Light Dimming Instrument. And it reacts to the Dome light switch and the overhead scales dimming knob. Comments may be sent to me per Sim Innovations Forum User Detlef.
